minLength.name: Minimum Length
minLength.description: Requires text to be at least {value} characters.
minLength.error: Field '{field}' must be at least {value} characters.

maxLength.name: Maximum Length
maxLength.description: Requires text to be no longer than {value} characters.
maxLength.error: Field '{field}' must be no longer than {value} characters.

length.name: Exact Length
length.description: Requires text to be exactly {value} characters.

pattern.name: Regex Pattern
pattern.description: Requires text to match the regular expression: {value}.

contains.name: Contains Text
contains.description: Requires text to contain the substring: {value}.

email.name: Email Address
email.description: Requires a valid email address format.
email.error: Field '{field}' must be a valid email address.

url.name: URL
url.description: Requires a valid HTTP or HTTPS URL.
url.error: Field '{field}' must be a valid URL.

uuid.name: UUID
uuid.error: Field '{field}' must be a valid UUID.

languageCode.name: Language Code
languageCode.description: Requires a well-formed BCP-47 language tag.
languageCode.error: Field '{field}' must be a valid language code.

lowercase.name: Lowercase
lowercase.description: Requires all characters to be lowercase.

uppercase.name: Uppercase
uppercase.description: Requires all characters to be uppercase.

trimmed.name: Trimmed
trimmed.description: Requires no leading or trailing whitespace.
trimmed.error: Field '{field}' must not have leading or trailing whitespace.

notEmpty.name: Not Empty
notEmpty.description: Requires text to contain at least one non-whitespace character.

text.name: Human-Readable Text
text.description: Marks a field as human-readable text.

notNull.name: Not Null
notNull.description: Requires the value to be present and not null.
notNull.error: Field '{field}' is required and must not be null.

enum.name: Allowed Values
enum.description: Restricts the value to a predefined list of allowed strings: {value}.
enum.error: Value '{value}' in field '{field}' is not in allowed values: {value}.

greaterThan.name: Greater Than
greaterThan.description: Requires the number to be strictly greater than {value}.
greaterThan.error: Field '{field}' must be strictly greater than {value}.

greaterThanOrEqual.name: Greater Than or Equal
greaterThanOrEqual.description: Requires the number to be greater than or equal to {value}.
greaterThanOrEqual.error: Field '{field}' must be greater than or equal to {value}.

lessThan.name: Less Than
lessThan.description: Requires the number to be strictly less than {value}.
lessThan.error: Field '{field}' must be strictly less than {value}.

lessThanOrEqual.name: Less Than or Equal
lessThanOrEqual.description: Requires the number to be less than or equal to {value}.
lessThanOrEqual.error: Field '{field}' must be less than or equal to {value}.

positive.name: Positive Number
positive.description: Requires a number strictly greater than zero.

negative.name: Negative Number
negative.description: Requires a number strictly less than zero.

positiveInteger.name: Positive Integer
positiveInteger.description: Requires a whole number strictly greater than zero.
positiveInteger.error: Field '{field}' must be a positive integer.

negativeInteger.name: Negative Integer
negativeInteger.description: Requires a whole number strictly less than zero.
negativeInteger.error: Field '{field}' must be a negative integer.

multipleOf.name: Multiple Of
multipleOf.description: Requires the number to be a multiple of {value}.
multipleOf.error: Field '{field}' must be a multiple of {value}.

precision.name: Decimal Precision
precision.description: Restricts the maximum number of decimal places to {value}.
precision.error: Field '{field}' cannot have more than {value} decimal places.

range.name: List Size Range
range.description: Restricts the number of items in a list to the range {value}.
range.error: Field '{field}' size must be within range {value}.

unique.name: Unique Items
unique.description: Requires all items in the list to be distinct.

isTrue.name: Is True
isTrue.description: Requires a boolean value to be true.

isFalse.name: Is False
isFalse.description: Requires a boolean value to be false.

dateFormat.name: Date Format
dateFormat.description: Requires date/time string to match format pattern: {value}.

isoDate.name: ISO Date
isoDate.description: Requires a valid ISO-8601 calendar date (YYYY-MM-DD).
isoDate.error: Field '{field}' must be a valid ISO-8601 date (YYYY-MM-DD).

isoDateTime.name: ISO Date-Time
isoDateTime.description: Requires a valid ISO-8601 date-time timestamp.
isoDateTime.error: Field '{field}' must be a valid ISO-8601 date-time timestamp.

isoTime.name: ISO Time
isoTime.error: Field '{field}' must be a valid ISO-8601 time (HH:mm:ss).

epoch.name: Epoch Seconds
epoch.description: Requires a whole-number Unix timestamp in seconds.
epoch.error: Field '{field}' must be a valid whole-number Unix timestamp in seconds.

epochMillis.name: Epoch Milliseconds
epochMillis.description: Requires a whole-number Unix timestamp in milliseconds.
epochMillis.error: Field '{field}' must be a valid whole-number Unix timestamp in milliseconds.

after.name: After Date
after.description: Requires date/time to be chronologically after {value}.

before.name: Before Date
before.description: Requires date/time to be chronologically before {value}.
